CLM-MAT-0211.statement: The full width at half maximum of the single Lorentzian fit to the 2D Raman peak of monolayer graphene is 22.70 cm⁻¹.

extra_quotes: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) height profiles [Figs. S1(d) and S1(e)] show that the top and bottom hBN layers, which serve as the gate dielectrics, both have a thickness of approximately 13 nm.
The reflection contrast measurements were performed in a vibration-isolated cryostat (Fermi Cryo-300) at a base temperature of 6 K.
